subject.title: fix(tools-manager): use BigInt for lossless Content-Length comparison

question: Should OpenClaw accept this behavior-neutral one-line simplification despite the existing comparison already enforcing the supported archive cap?
rationale: Repository policy discourages unsolicited refactor-only work, and code evidence cannot turn this into a supported behavior regression; accepting it therefore requires owner intent rather than an automated correctness judgment.

options.title: Decline the cleanup

options.title: Sponsor a narrow cleanup
options.body: Retain the BigInt simplification but remove or reframe the non-distinguishing test and describe the change explicitly as behavior-neutral maintenance.
